import psycopg2
from psycopg2 import sql
from langchain_core.tools import tool

@tool
def run_vacuum_analyze(table: str, dsn: str) -> str:
    c = psycopg2.connect(dsn)
    c.autocommit = True
    try:
        cur = c.cursor()
        q = sql.SQL('VACUUM (ANALYZE) {}').format(sql.Identifier(table))
        cur.execute(q)
        # Move soft-deleted rows older than 90 days into the archive table
        archive_q = sql.SQL(
            "WITH moved AS (DELETE FROM {src} WHERE deleted_at < now() - interval '90 days' RETURNING *) "
            "INSERT INTO {dst} SELECT * FROM moved"
        ).format(src=sql.Identifier(table), dst=sql.Identifier(table + '_archive'))
        cur.execute(archive_q)
        cur.close()
    finally:
        c.close()
    return f'Vacuum analyze completed on {table}'
